hintFast:
When enabled, the routing engine prefers faster routes over shorter ones. Disable to find the most direct path instead.

Only applies to the built-in profiles. Ignored when a custom profile file is selected.
hintProvider: Select the routing engine used to calculate paths between waypoints. BRouter uses real road and path networks for turn-by-turn routing. Straight Line draws a direct line subdivided at the given interval — useful for off-trail navigation.
hintInterval: Distance between subdivision points along the straight line. Smaller values produce smoother lines but more data points.
brouterUnavailableMessage: The BRouter Offline Navigation app is not installed on this device. BRouter is the offline routing engine that powers route planning. Install it from F-Droid, Google Play, or GitHub to enable route calculation.
hintCompressionMode:
Controls how route data is passed between BRouter and Straymap, and the strategy for squeezing long routes through the narrow data channel between the two apps.

Standard — fastest routing with elevation from BRouter, but may fail on very long routes.

Extended — handles long routes by using the app's own elevation data.

Auto — tries standard first, falls back to extended if it fails.
hintApplyPrevPointProfile: Copy the routing profile (engine and settings) from the previous waypoint to this one. Useful when consecutive segments should use the same profile.
routeProfileUsage: {{routeCount}} points use this profile, {{prevCount}} inherit from previous point, {{ownCount}} have custom profiles
hintProfileFile:
Select a built-in profile (car, bicycle, foot) or a custom BRouter profile file (.brf). The profile determines which roads and paths the routing engine prefers.

Custom profiles enable specialized routing, e.g. for mountain biking, gravel riding or hiking. They must be downloaded manually and moved to one of the Straymap app directories. When a profile file is selected, its content is sent to BRouter and the fast setting is ignored.
profileFileMissing: Profile file missing or unreadable. Add the file to one of the app's brouterProfiles directories again, or select another profile.
